data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 was $328.762m. During 2024 there was a gross increase in prior year provisions of $234.224m (a 71% increase versus opening gross reserves), driven by adverse prior-year developments and large-loss / geopolitical driven reserve movements. The Managing Agent cites geopolitical events (notably the Russia/Ukraine conflict), mid-sized losses on Energy, Power and Aviation books and broader adverse claims development as contributing factors. No single large named natural catastrophe is identified as the primary cause; the movements appear portfolio-wide and concentrated in specific underwriting years as reflected in the claims development tables.
raw_causal_phrases: The Russia/Ukraine Conflict has caused significant disruption to worldwide economies
Given the nature of the Russia/Ukraine Conflict, the ultimate losses relating to the event are subject to a high degree of uncertainty
the uncertain and complicated global geopolitical landscape that was exacerbated in 2023 by the Hamas attacks on Israel, the subsequent invasion of Gaza and the consequential ongoing effects
The underwriting result was impacted by mid-sized losses on the Energy, Power and Aviation books
losses from major, natural catastrophes had limited impact
This includes favourable development on the prior closed years of account
data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross prior-year movement sourced from the 'Change in prior year provisions' row in the Technical Provisions note (explicit gross figure = $234,224k). The report also contains narrative references to 'favourable development on the prior closed years of account' which refer to specific year-of-account closed outcomes and may be net of reinsurance; these narrative comments are not numeric and in places appear directionally inconsistent with the large gross strengthening recorded in the Technical Provisions table. The Russia/Ukraine reserve mention ($38.7m) is reported net of reinsurance; no gross quantified breakdown for that event is provided. Claims development triangle (gross) was used to capture development pattern; no RITC disclosure noted but users should be aware triangle values are presented in $'000 in-source and have been converted to millions for output.
